lines: I keep drifting farther from myself
The distance to you never closes
The sky was blue again today
And that alone is enough, isn’t it
I feel dirty somehow, and tears come
I want to sparkle
Spinning around, I found you
You were sparkling and I was frightened
Spinning around, you laughed
I heard the sound of the world changing
At midnight, the two of us, the words we couldn’t say
Words that shift at the throat
Even now the sky remains blue
Isn’t that all there is
I feel like I’m in the way
Tears come
I want to be needed
Singing “rura”, I was crying
Beside you, who was sparkling
At the corner of the spinning Earth
Dreaming of an impossible love
I feel dirty somehow
Tears come
I want to sparkle
I want to be loved by you
Spinning around, I found a place
It was warm, and I was frightened
The corner of the spinning Earth
Was filled with gentle love
Spinning around, I found you
You were sparkling and I was frightened
Spinning around, you laughed
I heard the sound of the world changing
Dreaming of an impossible love
